[B4] < deviceA | 'trusted' : Trusted , 'on' : false , ... > $ UserX 'turnOn' deviceA
=> < deviceA | 'trusted' : (UserX , Trusted) , 'on' : true , ... > .
[B5] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceA , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'turnOnCloud' cloudA | (deviceA)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceA , ...) , ... > $ cloudA 'turnOn' deviceA .
[B5] < deviceA | 'trusted' : Trusted , 'on' : false , ... > $ cloudA 'turnOn' deviceA
=> < deviceA | 'trusted' : Trusted , 'on' : true , ... > .
